report.clinical_summary: Patient with HIV on Triumeq for 3 years, currently with detectable viral load (340 copies/mL) after previously being undetectable. Adherence issues: 2-3 missed doses per week and occasional drug holidays. Patient attributes viral load increase to decreased adherence. Occasional headaches believed stress-related, no concerning symptoms of opportunistic infection. Patient acknowledges importance of consistent treatment but expresses concerns about side effects and indefinite nature of treatment.
